meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先判断计算放在哪里,再用 DuckDB 或 Polars 等引擎直接查询 CSV、Parquet、JSON,做分组、连接、聚合、时序、分布和清洗,需要时画图。整个过程不使用 pandas。
howto.when: 当你要分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据,做分组聚合或连接,清洗数据,或给数据集画图时触发。

say.text: 用 DuckDB 查这个 CSV,按类别分组统计数量
say.note: 直接扫文件,不整表加载

say.text: 找出这份 Parquet 里金额最高的 10 行
给这个数据集画一张分布图
say.note: 按可视化参考做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude decides where the computation runs, then queries CSV/Parquet/JSON in place with DuckDB or Polars for group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, and charts datasets on request. pandas is never used.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze CSV/Parquet/JSON data, run group-by, join or aggregation, clean a dataset, or plot its distributions.

say_en.text: Query this CSV with DuckDB and count rows by category
say_en.note: Scans the file, no full load

say_en.text: Find the 10 highest-amount rows in this Parquet file
Plot a distribution for this dataset
